title: Reconstruction from head positions
statement: Let $W$ be a finite machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a word over the schedule alphabet, and let $c$ be a configuration of the schedule controller on $x$. Reconstructing a macrostep configuration from $c$, using its own state and its actual unary-counter and guide head positions, gives $c$ itself.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite machine over the Boolean alphabet
$x$ is a word over the schedule alphabet
replaced:
Rebuilding a schedule configuration in macrostep form from its own state and its
actual unary and guide head positions returns the configuration itself.
